p5 now: three cards equal height, aligned. Title readable. But issue: vertical decorative text on left edge "拟议方向 · 待检验" is partially clipped/overlapping the page edge and renders vertically with characters cut. Actually it reads vertically at x≈50 — appears complete but very close to edge and overlapping the content line? It appears at left margin, slightly clipped? Letters appear rotated and cut at left edge partially. Hmm "拟议方向 · 待检验" vertical text: characters look partially cut (e.g. "拟" top partially outside). It's a minor brand decorative element, partially clipped by page edge. Noticeable.

Also card 01 headline breaks "联 合分析" awkwardly: line 1 "连接参数与多工况响应的联" line 2 "合分析" — split at mid-word "联合", poor line break. That is a typography improvement worth fixing: widen headline area or reduce font size so break falls between "的" and "联合分析".

Also text in card 03 not vertically balanced but acceptable.

So two improvements for p5: orphan-ish mid-word break in card 01 headline; left vertical decorative text clipping. p5 already used 2 reworks — limit reached (max 2 reworks per page). So can't revise again; per rules: 每页最多两次返工；还失败则 request_user. But these are improvements, not blockers. Remaining improvements can be reported in finish_deck remaining_issues. Rework limit applies to repair; already used twice for p5. So record visual assessment with these improvements and carry as remaining issues, delivery allowed since not blockers.

Record visual for p5 with those two improvements.
